highlighted_text.text: PHOENIX, AZ. (July 3, 2015) – Theranos, Inc. (Theranos) today applauded Arizona’s groundbreaking new Direct Access law, an important step toward a new era of preventive health care in our country
Theranos’ revolutionary lab services make tests more efficient, convenient, and affordable than ever before
Theranos lab tests are available in forty-two Theranos Wellness Centers in the Phoenix area, and Theranos is now expanding throughout the state

The legislation that enabled this change makes Arizona the first state to institute this comprehensive framework for laboratory testing, expressly recognizing individual’s rights to their own health information
Theranos also worked with Representative Heather Carter, Senator Nancy Barto, and many leaders in the physician community
Lab test data drive more than 70% of health decisions
Theranos, Inc. is a consumer health technology company founded in 2003 by Elizabeth Holmes
Theranos offers a comprehensive menu of lab tests in convenient locations in its Walgreens Wellness Centers in Arizona and California, with plans to expand throughout the country

facts: Theranos applauded Arizona's Direct Access law allowing individuals to obtain lab tests without a physician's order or insurance eligibility.
Theranos lab tests were available in 42 Theranos Wellness Centers in the Phoenix area.
Theranos prices were stated to be at least 50 to 80 percent below Medicare reimbursement rates.
Governor Doug Ducey stated that Arizona is the first state to institute this comprehensive framework for laboratory testing.
Dr. Matthew Baral testified on behalf of the direct access testing legislation in front of the Arizona State Senate.
